configuration.executablePath.description: Path to the micromamba executable. Leave empty to search PATH, MAMBA_EXE, and the root directory.
configuration.rootPrefix.description: Micromamba root directory. Leave empty to use MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX or micromamba info. Supports ~ and ${env:VARIABLE}.
configuration.channels.description: Channels used when creating environments and installing Conda packages.
configuration.autoActivateTerminal.descr: Automatically activate the selected micromamba environment in new interactive terminals for this workspace.
configuration.terminalActivationMode.des: Activation method for new terminals. Silent mode supports separate environments for workspace folders.
configuration.terminalActivationDelay.de: Milliseconds to wait for terminal startup when shell integration is unavailable. Used for command mode and manual activation.
configuration.commandTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for read-only commands such as environment discovery. Installation and creation have no timeout.
configuration.terminalActivationMode.sil: Inject activated environment variables before the terminal process starts, without displaying activation commands. The prompt may not show the environment name.
configuration.terminalActivationMode.com: Send shell hook and activation commands to the terminal, providing micromamba shell functions and the environment name in the prompt.
